name: Tsuyama Mutsuki
source: Mutsuki is a second-year at Tsurugama Academy. She was one of the members who played online with Satomi and Yumi when they found Momoko through the school's network. She collects the mahjong star trading card series. Mutsuki appears to be a very reliable girl, not to mention both a serious person and player.
